facts.name: Trimble
sentences: Trimble's shares moved 5% or more on 7 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 30 October 2026, when the stock fell 0.6%.
The stock is down 16.3% this year, and at $65.61 it sits 21.4% below its 52-week closing high of $83.52 from 5 December 2025.
$1,000 invested in Trimble five years ago would be worth $744 today.
